choice_basis: 1st-choice applicants and 1st-choice licenses drawn, per pool (res = resident, nr = nonresident, out = outfitter-assisted nonresident). q.res/q.nr/q.out = total licenses drawn into each pool across all choices (the file does not publish pool quotas); q.all = total licenses for the hunt code.
